C0680.title: Unauthorized Use of Scanning Software Leads to Classified Document Leak via Cloud Drive
C0680.summary: A government employee, seeking convenience, improperly used an internet-connected scanning application to digitize classified meeting minutes, causing the files to be automatically backed up to a cloud drive.
